title: Daily Workout · October 20
note: 57-minute workout. Begin with your regular five-minute stretching routine: lying quad stretch, butterfly stretch, seated spinal twist, and pigeon pose, with time to transition. Start the treadmill in New Balance shoes if comfortable; stop if tingling develops and change to Hokas after symptoms resolve.

items.name: Lying quad stretch
items.instructions: Lie on your side, gently bend the upper knee and bring the heel toward your glutes. Change sides halfway.

items.name: Butterfly stretch
items.instructions: Sit with soles together and knees comfortably out to the sides. Do not force the knees down.

items.name: Seated spinal twist
items.instructions: Sit upright and rotate gently within a comfortable range. Avoid forcing the twist.

items.name: Pigeon pose
items.instructions: Ease into each side without forcing the hip or groin; use support if needed.

items.name: Easy reset and position changes
items.instructions: Take your time rising and getting ready for the treadmill.

items.name: Steady walk
items.instructions: Keep effort conversational. Stop if tingling develops.

items.name: Brisk walk
items.instructions: Choose the lower end if needed; no jogging required.

items.name: Dumbbell floor press
items.instructions: Use manageable weights and breathe throughout.

items.name: Forearm plank
items.detail: 2 minutes · 2 sets of 40–60 seconds with rest
items.instructions: Keep a straight line and stop if groin or back discomfort occurs.

items.name: Side steps with arm swings
items.instructions: Step lightly and move arms in a flowing rhythm.

items.name: Alternating forward steps
items.instructions: Small controlled forward and back steps.

items.name: Parting the horse's mane
items.instructions: Coordinate gentle steps with flowing arm movements.

items.name: Brush knee and push
items.instructions: Slow arm sweep and push with each step.
